title: Important Regulatory Updates: MCA, GST, and Income Tax Deadlines Extended & Clarified!
content:
# Important Regulatory Updates: MCA, GST, and Income Tax Deadlines Extended & Clarified!

Ek important update hai. Government ne corporate compliance, GST, aur Income Tax ke liye kuch crucial relaxations aur clarifications announce kiye hain. Companies, businesses, aur taxpayers, please note!

### Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA)

MCA ne Financial Year 2025-26 ke liye financial statements aur annual returns ki filing timelines extend kar di hain, taaki companies ko additional fees na lage.

*   **Form AOC-4 (Financial Statements):** Ab aap 31st December, 2026 tak file kar sakte hain.
*   **Form MGT-7/7A (Annual Returns):** Iski extended due date 31st January, 2027 hai.
*   **Important Note:** Yeh extension Annual General Meetings (AGMs) hold karne ki deadline ko change nahi karta hai. AGMs apne statutory timelines ke hisaab se hi honge.
*   Yeh relief General Circular No. 05/2026, dated October 24, 2026, ke through announce kiya gaya hai. MCA expects ki is fee waiver ko implement karne ke liye necessary system changes October 29, 2026 tak complete ho jayenge.

### Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC)

CBIC ne October 26, 2026 ko multiple circulars issue kiye hain, jisme Goods and Services Tax (GST) regime ke various aspects par comprehensive guidelines provide ki gayi hain.

*   **GST Registration Procedures:** Nayi circulars mein GST registration ke liye detailed guidelines provide ki gayi hain, jisse process smoother hone ki ummeed hai. Tax officers ko unwarranted documents ya irrelevant queries poochne se roka gaya hai.
*   **50% Input Tax Credit (ITC) Option for Banks & NBFCs:** Circular No. 261/07/2026-GST, dated October 26, 2026, ne Section 17(4) of the CGST Act ke under banks, financial institutions, aur NBFCs ke liye 50% ITC option par clarity di hai.
*   **Retrospective Effect of Omission of Rule 96(10) of CGST Rules:** Circular No. 264/10/2026-GST, dated October 26, 2026, ne confirm kiya hai ki Rule 96(10) ka omission retrospective effect se, yani 23rd October, 2017 se, लागू होगा.

### Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT)

CBDT ne October 27, 2026 ko Income-tax (Seventh Amendment) Rules, 2026, propose kiye hain.

*   **New Rule 281A and Form 173A:** Ye naye rules Rule 281A aur ek naya Form 173A introduce karte hain.
*   **Purpose:** Form 173A un assessees ke liye mandatory hai jo Income-tax Act, 2025 ke Schedule IV ke entries 13D aur 13E ke under Government securities se hone wale interest income aur capital gains par exemption claim karna chahte hain.
*   Yeh rules Notification No. 137/2026 ke through October 19, 2026 ko notify kiye gaye the aur Official Gazette mein publish hone ki date se effective honge.
